resolution.note: required outputs and report consistency enforced by the worker driver; driver-run checks in t-n9b3q2g, verify red-first in t-1xyccee

title: Accept worker turns by checks the driver runs
body: Outcome: independent acceptance after a worker turn, part one: `--require <path>` on `krn worker start` (repeatable, stored in the session, applies to every turn) makes a turn exit 4 with `missing required output <path>` when that path is not among the turn's changed paths, even when the report says `done`; and the driver refuses an inconsistent report with exit 4: a `done` report with any check `exit_code != 0`, or `changed_paths` naming a path the diff does not contain, or the diff containing a path the report omits. Source: .krn/runs/lead/worker-audit/code-audit.md fixes 2 and 4. Fix 3 (driver-run checks, canary) and fix 5 (verify red-first required) are split into their own tasks. Proof: observers test/worker/required-outputs.test.ts and test/worker/report-consistency.test.ts, each red at base by assertion.
